components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-primary { height: 54px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #007F94; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 17px 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover, .ds-primary:active { background: #006D80; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #E86662; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border-radius: 20px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #24333A; font: 600 17px 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: A quiet moment after the drive.
narrative.overview: The interface borrows the supplied reference's soft color fields, approachable rounded type, simple centered composition, and clear turquoise action. The mood is reassuring and curious.

rules.name: The Calm Surface Rule
rules.body: Use sky for Home, sea glass for History and Recording, and a near-white canvas for the recap.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Avenir Next throughout with sentence case.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: The main action is teal with white text and at least a 44pt touch target. The graph supports dragging the marker to read time and speed.

dos: Do label fuel and CO₂ as estimates, and credit the recorded data in the Home info sheet.
Do keep live recording free of scores and coaching prompts.
donts: Don't use uppercase display slogans, neon accents, dense nesting, or decorative speed lines.
Don't imply that a motion spike establishes fault or that the app measures emissions directly.
